section1Text1: The WazzimaGiygg case reveals an advanced stage of ethical insolvency and systemic failure in Lusophone Wikipedia. The deliberate rupture between the civil and digital identity of a contributor is not an isolated incident, but a symptom of an ecosystem that operates as a "State within a State", where privacy norms are sacrificed in the name of personal vendettas. The chronic inactivity of the Arbitration Committee (ArbCom) allowed the rise of an autocratic "digital aristocracy", applying "Summary Justice" — such as the block log in just 4 minutes, without due process or the right to defense.
warningSEO: ⚠️ SEVERITY ALERT: The exposure of Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres's civil name resulted in devastating and permanent "SEO Damage". Currently, the Wikipedia doxxing log appears as the second global result on Google for the victim's name, destroying their professional and personal reputation.

section3Title: 3. Legal Framework: LGPD, Marco Civil and Penal Code
marcoCivilList: Art. 7, II - Inviolability and secrecy of communications flow: The public disclosure that the user allegedly sent "emails with threats" violates the secrecy of private communications, even if they had existed (which was not proven).
Art. 7, IX - No undue suspension of connection: The global block applied without due process and without conclusive evidence violates this fundamental right.
Art. 10 - Storage and protection of records: The CheckUser logs that link the real name to the user's nickname should not have been made publicly available, violating intimacy and honor.
Art. 19 - Platform responsibility (STF 2025 interpretation): The Wikimedia Foundation can be held subsidiarily liable if, after extrajudicial notification, it does not remove defamatory content.
lgpdList: Art. 6 - Principles of data processing: The processing of the user's data was done without good faith, with deviation of purpose (persecution, not platform protection).
Art. 7 - Processing hypotheses: There was no consent from the data subject, nor legitimate interest of the controller that justifies vexatious public exposure.
Art. 20 - Right to review automated decisions: The community applied automatic blocks based on device fingerprinting (IMEI/MAC collection) without offering a human channel for contestation.

Art. 42 - Civil liability: The moral damage is evident: public exposure as a "criminal", linking the real name in public logs, and the so-called "SEO Damage" (real name permanently associated with false accusations in search engines).
codigoPenalList: Art. 138 - Slander: Chronus falsely imputed to the user the crime of threat (Art. 147 of the Penal Code) without presenting any evidence. Penalty: detention of 6 months to 2 years.
Art. 139 - Defamation: Publicly attributing an offensive fact to reputation (criminal accusation). Penalty: detention of 3 months to 1 year.
Art. 140 - Injury: Terms like "lazy puppet", "guy" and the criminal accusation itself without evidence constitute direct attacks on dignity. Penalty: detention of 1 to 6 months.

Art. 147-A - Stalking: Repeated persecution by Chronus, monitoring the user's life outside the platform (social networks, forums, photographs). Penalty: imprisonment of 6 months to 2 years (+1/3 for crimes committed through the internet).

Art. 154-A - Computer device intrusion: Use of scripts to capture physical hardware identifiers (IMEI and MAC Address) and collection of photo metadata (exif) without authorization. Penalty: imprisonment of 1 to 4 years.

Art. 288 - Criminal Association: Chronus, Edmond Dantès and Little Sunshine acted in coordination to build a false narrative, justify blocks without due process and prevent the user's defense. Penalty: imprisonment of 1 to 3 years.

Art. 339 - Malicious Denunciation: Chronus falsely imputed the crime of threat; Little Sunshine, by saying "maybe now it's feasible", caused the investigation against an innocent person to continue. Penalty: imprisonment of 2 to 8 years.

techNoteTitle: 📌 Critical Technical Note - Data Retention Policy Violation:
techNoteText: The global CheckUser policy establishes that IP data expires in 90 days. The fact that administrators technically linked the account "Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres" (inactive for over 5 months/150 days) proves a frontal violation of the data retention policy or access to logs that should have been permanently deleted. This "technical lie" exposes a critical security and ethics failure, in addition to constituting violation of the LGPD (Art. 46 - Security in data processing).
section7Title: 7. The degradation of the user's legitimate contributions
section7Text1: The user made high-quality contributions to Wikipedia and legitimate photographs of the city of Santa Fé do Sul on Wikimedia Commons. These contributions were used as "proof" to persecute him — which is a degradation of his art and work and an attack on his freedom of expression and creation, protected by Art. 5, IV and IX of the Federal Constitution.
contribWarningText: The accounts "Fantasmadaserie1100" (Skyscrapercity forum) and "Chadecesio" (Wikimedia Commons) made legitimate and high-quality contributions. The administrator, by persecuting them, not only violated the user's privacy, but also punished useful contributions to the platform — which demonstrates that the persecution was independent of any unlawful act committed by the user. It was pure and simple witch hunting.

recommendationsList: Independent Audit: Immediate review of CheckUser logs operated by Edmond Dantès and Johannesn89 to identify access to expired data (>90 days).
LGPD Take-down: Mandatory and definitive removal of Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres's personal data from all public logs and indexers (Google).
Global Demotion: Immediate revocation of the administrator, bureaucrat and checkuser status of agents involved in doxxing and persecution.
Review of Automated Blocks: Implementation of a human channel for contesting blocks based on fingerprinting, as per Art. 20 of the LGPD.
Notification to ANPD: Investigation into the data processing carried out by the Wikimedia Foundation, especially regarding the cross-referencing of data between sister projects.
Criminal Action: Filing of action against Chronus, Edmond Dantès and Little Sunshine for slander, malicious denunciation, criminal association, stalking and device intrusion.
Civil Action for Moral Damages: Claim for compensation for the permanent SEO Damage and for the vexatious public exposure.
finalText1: The omission in the face of this report reaffirms the collapse of digital governance in Lusophone Wikipedia. The sovereignty of privacy and the right to be forgotten must prevail over the abuse of administrative power. The era of technical impunity under the veil of volunteerism must be ended through administrative or judicial means.
finalText2: The evidence documented in this dossier is irrefutable: there is proven doxxing, coordinated persecution (criminal association), malicious denunciation, device intrusion and multiple violations of the LGPD and the Marco Civil da Internet. The Wikimedia Foundation has subsidiary responsibility and must be held accountable.
